settings.title: Settings
settings.app_quota_checkbox: Limit usage time per day (instead of a total block)

help.blocking_explanation: If you block a site, your child cannot access it. They won't see a MintGuard message, but their browser's usual error screen (e.g. "Unable to connect"): that's normal, it means the block is working, not that the internet is broken.
help.how_it_works_explanation: MintGuard monitors which websites and applications your child uses, then applies the restrictions you configured.
help.category_explanation: A category groups similar websites together. For example, 'Social Media' includes Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, etc.
help.why_pin_explanation: This code prevents your child from changing the settings without your consent. You can change it later in Settings.
help.time_limit_explanation: Outside allowed hours, your child's session closes automatically. You can change these hours at any time.
help.what_is_app_blocking: What does blocking an application mean?
help.app_blocking_explanation: If you block an application, your child won't be able to open it. If it's already running, it closes automatically.
help.what_is_daily_budget: What is a daily time budget?
help.daily_budget_explanation: On top of the schedule above, you can set a maximum number of minutes used per day. Once that time is exceeded, your child's session closes automatically for the rest of the day.
help.what_is_app_quota: What is a limited time for an application?
help.app_quota_explanation: Instead of fully blocking the application, you allow your child to use it up to a number of minutes per day. Once that time is exceeded, the application closes automatically until the next day.
